# Webumi

> Webumi ([webumi.com.au](https://webumi.com.au/)) is an Australian web and AI studio for small and mid-sized businesses. It builds landing pages, business websites, apps (PWA, iOS and Android), custom platforms, automations and AI assistants. Run by a small team of professionals in Australia (ABN 42 183 713 603). Works with clients Australia-wide, online.

Tagline: "More customers. Less admin." — Web, AI & Automation for Small & Mid-Sized Business.

## Who Webumi helps
- Tradies and home services: plumbers, electricians, builders, landscapers, cleaners, pool, pest control
- Beauty, hair, nails, massage and wellness
- Pet grooming and pet care
- Tutors, coaches, consultants and photographers
- Any Australian small or mid-sized business that wants more enquiries, online bookings or less admin

## Services and starting prices (AUD)
- Two design levels for every landing page, website and app. Essential: a proven layout in the client's logo, colours and fonts with subtle animations. Signature: a custom design with a hero animation or video, scroll effects, interactive sliders and video sections (landing page from $1,190, business website from $2,490, app +$2,900). Same speed and SEO foundation on both.
- Landing page — from $590 (Essential): one page with one goal (calls, bookings or sign-ups), designed for phones, enquiry form with instant reply, Google Business Profile setup. Usually live in 1–2 weeks.
- Business website — from $1,290 (Essential): up to 10 pages (extra pages $120 each), service and area pages for Google search, Google Business Profile and reviews. Usually live in 2–4 weeks.
- Website extras (fixed prices): domain + hosting for 1 year $190, persuasive copy & slogan $190 / $390, stock images $70 / $150, custom art & illustrations $190 / $390 (natural, realistic AI photos are included free when the client has no photos), logo & mini brand kit $390, online booking $390, payments & deposits $290, smart quote form $290, CRM setup $390, email marketing $290, Google reviews on the site $150, ads & conversion tracking $290, WhatsApp button $50, business email $90, simple content editor $190 / $390, WordPress $390 / $590, online store from $1,290, AI assistant from $390 plus AI usage. Full price list and builder: [Pricing](https://webumi.com.au/pricing/)
- Faster delivery: Rush +25% (about half the time) or Express +50% (landing page in 1–2 business days, website in 5 business days).
- App — web app (PWA) from $8,900; iOS & Android app from $14,900. Usually 6–12 weeks.
- Platform — from $15,000: client portals, dashboards, internal tools, marketplaces and SaaS products, starting with a focused first version (MVP). Usually 8–16 weeks.
- Custom AI agents (a chat that asks questions and produces a quote, plan or report as a PDF) and automations (Xero, Stripe, Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs): quoted per project. AI can be added to existing websites (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify).
- Website fixes and redesigns: quoted after a free review.
- Support after launch: for 30 days, issues with the agreed functionality are fixed at no extra cost; then Care $49/month, Care Plus $99/month or Growth $199/month (domain and hosting included, cancel anytime). Care includes 3 updates a month, Care Plus 6 (unused ones carry over), Growth 10 plus a new page or blog post and SEO and AI search optimisation every month. One update = changes to one page (text, photos or prices), done within 3 business days.
- Free website planner: answer a few questions and get a plan with pages and a price: [Plan my website](https://webumi.com.au/plan/)

## How it works
1. Tell us about your business in a guided form and share any branding, photos or text you already have. Webumi identifies anything else the project needs, such as a logo, copywriting or photos.
2. A fixed quote within 1 business day. Sign the agreement online and pay the 50% deposit.
3. Three homepage design concepts around the brand and goals; the client chooses one and it is refined together.
4. A visual sitemap of every page (or each section of a landing page) for approval.
5. The remaining pages designed and the copy written or polished, approved before building.
6. A preview of the working website on phones and computers for final feedback, usually 2–4 weeks from the start.
7. Launch on the client's domain (final 50%) and a 30-minute handover. For 30 days, issues with the agreed functionality are fixed at no extra cost. The client owns everything — domain, website and accounts.
